## Hermes
- Loads from a plugin directory carrying `plugin.yaml` + `__init__.py`. Two verified paths (hermes_cli/plugins.py): local dev — copy this directory to `~/.hermes/plugins/docs/` (user plugin) or `./.hermes/plugins/docs/` with `HERMES_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLUGINS=1` (project plugin, opt-in) — then `hermes plugins list` should show it; from a Git host — `hermes plugins install owner/repo`, then `hermes plugins enable docs` (or pass `--enable` to `install`) to activate it — install alone does not enable a plugin. Hermes has no marketplace file, so there is no registry listing step beyond the two paths above.
